backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining data types (Person, Achievement, Event, LockerBill, EquipmentItem, LockerDocument, DriveLink, UserProfile) and CRUD operations with role-based access control (admin/user permissions) using stable storage maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: replacing the logo with 'baja logo.jpg' in Layout.tsx and replacing the cover photo with 'image page.jpg' in Home.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components including modals for adding content, card components for displaying data, hooks for backend queries, and styling configuration with motorsports-themed colors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color variables for a motorsports-inspired theme including racing red, carbon black, metallic silver, and other UI colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title 'VVCEBAJA' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, team, achievements, events, and protected member locker sections, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dark mode default.
Card component displaying achievement details with optional image, title, date, description, and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/AddAchievementMo: Modal dialog for adding achievements with form fields for title, date, description, and multiple image uploads with progress tracking using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/AddBillModal.tsx: Modal component for uploading bills with fields for title, amount, date, comments, and an image file. Handles file upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob and integrates with useAddBill hook.
frontend/src/components/AddDocumentModal: Modal component for uploading documents with fields for title, description, tags, and a file attachment. Supports file upload with progress tracking and uses useAddDocument hook for backend integration.
frontend/src/components/AddDriveLinkModa: Modal component for adding external drive links with title, URL, and description fields. Validates URLs and uses useAddDriveLink hook to persist links without file uploads.
frontend/src/components/AddEquipmentModa: Modal component for adding equipment inventory with fields for name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, description, comments, and an image. Handles image upload with progress tracking via useAddEquipment hook.
frontend/src/components/AddEventModal.ts: Modal component for creating events with title, date, location, description, and optional multiple images. Supports batch image uploads with progress tracking using useAddEvent hook.
frontend/src/components/AddPhotoModal.ts: Modal dialog for uploading multiple photo files with progress tracking, using ExternalBlob for file handling and displaying upload percentage.
frontend/src/components/AddTeamMemberMod: Modal form for adding team members with name, Principal ID, role, contact info, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/BillCard.tsx: Displays a bill with image, amount, date, author, and comments; includes download and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/DocumentCard.tsx: Card component showing document details with tags, upload date, author, and download/delete actions for admins.
frontend/src/components/DriveLinkCard.ts: Card displaying a drive link with title, description, date, author, and external link button with admin delete option.
frontend/src/components/EquipmentCard.ts: Equipment item card showing image, name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, and admin delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Event card displaying title, date, location, images, and description with admin delete option for non-past events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header, responsive navigation menu, logo, login button, and footer. Includes mobile menu toggle and navigation links for Home, Team, Achievements, Events, and Member Locker.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login/logout states using Internet Identity. Handles authentication flow, displays loading state, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Grid-based photo gallery component that displays locker documents sorted by upload date. Opens a lightbox modal when photos are clicked.
frontend/src/components/PhotoLightbox.ts: Full-screen photo viewer with navigation controls, keyboard shortcuts, download functionality, and admin-only delete capability. Displays photo metadata and handles navigation between images.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name. Prevents dismissal until profile is created and saves user profile data.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that checks authentication status and displays loading state or login prompt for unauthenticated users. Renders children only when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Card component displaying team member information including image, name, role, and contact info. Includes admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/UpcomingEventsPr: Displays up to 3 upcoming events in a preview card format with date, title, description, and location. Shows loading state and links to full events page.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: React Query hooks for managing achievements including fetching all achievements, adding, updating, and removing achievements with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state. Handles anonymous and authenticated actors, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing events: fetching all events, adding, updating, and removing events via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication with React context, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerBills.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker bills: fetching all bills, adding new bills, and deleting bills via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDocuments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker documents: fetching all documents, adding new documents, and deleting documents via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDriveLinks.t: Provides React Query hooks for managing drive links: fetching all drive links, adding new links, and deleting links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerEquipment.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing equipment items: fetching all equipment, adding new equipment, and deleting equipment via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, team members, achievements, and all locker-related data (bills, equipment, documents, drive links).
frontend/src/hooks/useTeamMembers.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing team members: fetching all people, adding, updating, and removing person records via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and motorsports-inspired color palette (racing red, carbon black, metallic silver, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutTeam.tsx: Team members page displaying a grid of team member cards with admin controls to add/edit/remove members, showing loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Displays a paginated list of team achievements sorted by date, with admin controls to add new achievements via a modal. Shows loading state and empty state with trophy icon.
frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx: Displays events split into upcoming and past sections, sorted by date, with admin controls to add new events. Includes loading and empty states with calendar icon.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with hero section featuring team image and navigation cards linking to team, achievements, events, and member locker sections. Includes upcoming events preview component.
frontend/src/pages/LockerBills.tsx: Displays financial bills sorted by date with add/upload functionality. Includes back navigation to member locker and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDocuments.tsx: Shows team documents with search functionality filtering by title, description, or tags. Includes upload modal, back navigation, and empty/no-results states.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDriveLinks.tsx: Displays external storage drive links sorted by date added, with add link functionality and back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerEquipment.tsx: Shows equipment inventory sorted by purchase date with add equipment modal and back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerPhotos.tsx: React page component that displays a photo gallery filtered from locker documents, with upload functionality via AddPhotoModal and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/MemberLocker.tsx: React page component that renders a dashboard grid of member locker sections (Bills, Equipment, Documents, Photos, Drive Links) with navigation links and icons.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (racing-red, carbon-black, metallic-silver, etc.), container settings, border radius variables, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking VVCEBAJA app features, including completed logo and cover page replacements, with schema version 1.0.0 and project state version 3.
